scope: Read-only investigation of old production Supabase project lzciyzibqbujshoizlbu

confirmed_http_402.meaning: Supabase documents HTTP 402 as a Fair Use Policy service restriction. The response body normally includes the reason code, such as exceeded_* quota or overdue_payment.
confirmed_http_402.important_limitation: Unified logs expose status and request metadata but not the HTTP 402 response body or Fair Use reason code. Therefore exact restriction cause (egress, database size, other quota, or overdue payment) is not proven.

findings.platform_state: Management API reports ACTIVE_HEALTHY; this does not negate API gateway-level Fair Use restrictions.
findings.likely_interpretation: A platform-level organization service restriction is substantially more consistent with cross-service 402s than an application bug, invalid password, RLS policy, or one Edge Function defect.

cash_safety.note: No financial data changed. P4 tariff discrepancy remains unresolved pending approval and complete reconciliation.

recovery_path: Obtain the exact 402 reason code from the API response or Supabase organization billing/usage page.
If quota-based, wait for quota reset or reduce the specific usage driver; do not upgrade because the user requires free-only.
If overdue_payment, resolve the billing account issue; do not assume it applies solely from status 402.
After restriction clears, verify Auth login, REST reads, Edge Functions, chat and storage with safe test accounts before changing production.
